heading: Definition
lead: For purposes of this chapter, “State” includes the District of Columbia and the territories and possessions of the United States.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 4010136:2613.Aug. 17, 1984, Pub. L. 98–382, § 14, 98 Stat. 1345. The words “the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico” are omitted as included in “the territories and possession of the United States”.
